name: workflow
description: Technical/functional mediation commands and agents (/analyst, /arquiteto, /flow, /spike, /qa, /infra), plus skills for test-failure triage, code review, commit conventions, migrating a legacy .claude/ to these plugins and an exploratory HTTP client for the local API. Also /grill-me, a round-based interview that /flow also uses to grill its specialist agents, and domain-modeling, which keeps the project glossary (GLOSSARY.md) and ADRs. Stack-agnostic — project-specific conventions live in each repo's CLAUDE.md.
